reading: Wanshan-Yongxing supplies three source-native matched-plant effects with plant-level uncertainty. Ogasawara now supplies three numeric Anijima anole-context effects, but those rows are context-specific and not commensurate with the continental-island/oceanic-island contrast. No compatible effect family yet has uncertainty in two independent system clusters.
claim_boundary: Plant-level bootstrap uncertainty does not create independent islands, invasion contexts, or archipelagos. Effect rows with different exposures must not be pooled merely because their response metric is similar.
